title: Lifeboat on-load release hooks: what changed, how they work, what to check

scenes.label: KNOW YOUR EQUIPMENT
scenes.heading: A hook that opens too early drops the boat.
scenes.narration: A lifeboat hook that opens too early drops the boat and its crew. So the rules for these hooks were rewritten.

scenes.label: TERM
scenes.heading: On-load release
scenes.body: Hooks that can open with the boat's weight still on them.
scenes.narration: On-load release opens the hooks with the boat's weight still on them. It is the emergency option, so it must be hard to use by mistake.

scenes.label: LSA CODE 4.4.7.6
scenes.heading: What a compliant hook must do
scenes.narration: A fully reset hook must stay stable under load. A hydrostatic interlock, or other means, confirms the boat is waterborne. Release on load needs multiple, deliberate actions.

scenes.label: SOLAS III/1.5
scenes.heading: Non-compliant hooks replaced
scenes.narration: Non-compliant hooks were replaced at the first dry-docking after 1 July 2014, and no later than 1 July 2019.

scenes.label: BEFORE YOU HOIST
scenes.heading: See every hook fully reset
scenes.narration: Before hoisting, see every hook fully reset and its indicator agree. Where a fall preventer is still required, fit it, and remove it before release.

scenes.label: SINCE 1 JANUARY 2020
scenes.heading: Who examines the release gear
scenes.narration: Since 2020, the crew does weekly and monthly checks. The annual examination and five-yearly overhaul need an authorised service provider.

scenes.label: KEY TAKEAWAY
scenes.heading: Not seen reset? Do not trust it.
scenes.narration: Not seen the hook reset? Do not trust it.

factCheck.notes: LSA Code 4.4.7.6 as amended by MSC.320(89): stability when fully reset with no force to operating mechanism (.4), hydrostatic interlock unless other means ensure waterborne, multiple deliberate and sustained action for on-load release (.7.2) - Hong Kong MD text of the amendment. SOLAS III/1.5 replacement at first scheduled dry-docking after 1 July 2014, not later than 1 July 2019 - West P&I, MCA MGN 541, LR. FPD use until compliant and locking pins removed before release (MSC.1/Circ.1327) - West P&I. MSC.402(96) from 1 January 2020: weekly/monthly by crew under a senior officer or ASP, annual thorough examination and five-yearly overhaul/overload test by certified maker or ASP personnel - Gard. Indicator check is general good practice.

meta.description: How lifeboat on-load release hooks must work under the amended LSA Code: stable when reset, a hydrostatic interlock and a deliberate release on load. Why SOLAS III/1.5 forced replacement by 1 July 2019, what to check before hoisting, and who examines the gear since 1 January 2020.
